messages:
maria-support: heads up — customer reported 422 from /invoke-tool with a JSON schema validation error. Error claims additionalProperties for "billing_profile" and a type mismatch for "order_id". putting request + error below.

maria-support: ```json
Request: {
  "tool": "order-processor.v2",
  "payload": {
    "user_id": 9876,
    "order_id": "12345",       // should be integer per schema
    "items": [ { "sku": "X-1", "qty": 1 } ],
    "billing_profile": { "tier": "pro" }  // extra field
  }
}

Response: 422 ValidationError: additionalProperties "billing_profile" not allowed at /payload; type mismatch: "order_id" expected integer, got string
```

devlin-eng: can you paste the exact request_id and which environment (prod/staging)? also which SDK version is the client on?

maria-support: request_id=rid_20230315_5467, occurred in prod at 2023-11-08T15:22Z. customer says they upgraded mobile SDK this week -> may have started sending billing_profile.

jake-se: quick glance at tool registry: function schema for order-processor.v2 expects "order_id" as integer and has additionalProperties: false on payload. client is sending camelCase/extra fields. two follow-ups: 1) client-side should be fixed to send integer and snake_case; 2) server could be more lenient (ignore unknown props) or add a coercion pass.

sam-qa: repro steps I ran: curl against prod/invoke with the same body -> got identical 422. repro on staging too. logs show validation happening in schema-validator v1.4.2. short log: 
```
[2023-11-08T15:22:01Z] rid_20230315_5467 VALIDATION_FAIL payload.order_id type=string expected=integer
[2023-11-08T15:22:01Z] rid_20230315_5467 VALIDATION_FAIL additionalProperties=['billing_profile']
```

devlin-eng: prioritizing this — creating INF ticket and looping in eng-runtime. proposed short-term mitigation: add a tolerant mode flag for the endpoint to coerce numeric strings and drop unknown top-level keys. long-term: update registry schema if this extra field is intended.

devlin-eng: INF-4123 created and assigned to eng-runtime. tagging @eng-runtime for visibility. can someone from SDK team confirm whether recent SDK added billing_profile automatically?

maria-support: @jake-se can you follow up with SDK folks? i will message the customer with a workaround (strip billing_profile and send order_id as integer) and ETA. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Ticket INF-4123 created (severity: medium) — assignee: eng-runtime — link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4123

jake-se: noted, i'll open a quick PR to add schema-coercion behind a feature flag and ping SDK team.

maria-support: thanks everyone — keeping thread updated when customer confirms workaround.
